sentences.cn: 嗨，这个视频里我想稍微聊聊我今晚的安排。

sentences.en: In this video I'm going to talk a little bit about my plans for tonight.
sentences.cn: 嗨，这个视频里我想稍微聊聊我今晚的安排。

sentences.en: So right now I am at a park.
You can kind of see the park here, and I'm going to go running.
sentences.cn: 你能大概看到这边的公园，我准备去跑步。

sentences.en: I'm going to run for about 40 minutes and I am going to get some exercise I really need to run.
sentences.cn: 我会跑差不多 40 分钟，活动活动身体，我真的太需要跑了。

sentences.en: I try to run one hour every day, and then after I run, I'm going to take some photos of the park because I love this park and I'm going to share them with my friends.
sentences.cn: 我尽量每天都跑 1 个小时。跑完之后，我打算给这个公园拍些照片，因为我特别喜欢这个公园，还想跟朋友们分享。

sentences.en: I'm going to post on Facebook, and then after that I am going to drive home, and then I'm going to have dinner with my family.
sentences.cn: 我要发到脸书上，然后开车回家，再跟家人一起吃晚饭。

sentences.en: I think tonight we're going to have pizza, although I'm not sure.
sentences.cn: 今晚我觉得我们可能吃披萨，不过我也不太确定。

sentences.en: And then after dinner, I think I'm going to relax and chat with my mom and my dad, and then I'm going to go to bed early.
sentences.cn: 吃完晚饭，我大概会放松一下，跟爸妈聊聊天，然后就早点睡。

sentences.en: I'm not going to stay up late because tomorrow I have to get up early because I'm going to drive to another city and I'm going to meet my niece and nephew because my nephew is getting married.
sentences.cn: 我不打算熬夜，因为明天得早起，我要开车去另一座城市，去见我的外甥女和侄子，因为我侄子要结婚了。

sentences.en: So I'm going to be doing a lot of things, so I'm going to be very busy.
sentences.cn: 所以接下来事情不少，我会特别忙。
